hypothesis: Scope placement plus navigation may change recall and retrieval cost with identical memory bodies; no required direction of effect.

dev.purpose: Check execution, isolation and measurement; not evidence of effectiveness.

answer_quality: No regex answer checks; reference answers are for dataset semantic review. No task-success claim.
analysis: Average repeats per case; equal case weighting; bootstrap scene/session clusters; descriptive percentile 95% CI without multiplicity correction. Shared templates limit independence and generalization.
discriminability: Report oracle-vs-lexical offline diagnostic separately from real Agent comparisons. Report null/ceiling/negative effects and direction of cost changes. A nonzero interval applies only to this controlled synthetic set.
stopping: Complete the frozen matrix independent of quality. Preserve failures and missing values; do not silently retry, select seeds, revise gold, remove test cases or tune from test outcomes.
runtime_limits: Fresh Docker and separate verifier per trial; shared host and provider cache, no network hard isolation. Keep runtime logs local and publish numeric summaries.
